source_range: The current contiguous Sovereign Standard vessel range, beginning with unit 0
construction: Study 0010 remains intact. Study 0011 removes the six camera presets and locks its room rules as a reusable instrument. Selecting a vessel replaces only the canonical 64-state path; the same depth, entered-room, open-edge, glass-frontier, scaffold, point, light, and orbit rules are recomputed without per-vessel tuning.
invariants: every vessel contributes exactly its canonical 64 ordered sigil positions
depth remains the mean row of the incoming canonical swap
the Study 0010 room, edge, face, scaffold, point, material, and light rules
one rigid upward presentation rotation per selected path
manual orbit and automatic rotation change only the camera
saved sigils are private Studio records and do not issue, mint, or alter a vessel

controls.vessel: load any sigil in the current snapshotted vessel range
controls.saved: load a sigil previously saved by the Studio steward
controls.save: persist the selected vessel and its visibility switches as a private Studio working record
controls.lines: show or hide frontier-safe entered-room edges
controls.sides: show or hide transparent frontier faces
controls.red_line: show or hide the selected canonical path
controls.red_dot: show or hide its final point
controls.scaffold: show or hide all 300 edges of the 4 by 4 by 4 room field
controls.unconnected_points: show or hide lattice points touching no entered room
controls.rotate: turn automatic camera rotation on or off
controls.orbit: drag freely through a full 360-degree inspection
